posts.zh:
dsh-start 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。macOS 上 DSH Web 的一键启停启动器：前台/后台启动、停止、状态、防重复启动、自动打开浏览器，并可用脚本构建程序坞版 DSH.app。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6e32a4f99202c212ffaa.html
posts.en:
dsh-start is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. One-click start/stop launcher for DSH Web on macOS — start (foreground/daemon), stop, status, duplicate-launch guard, auto browser open, plus a Dock-able DSH.app built by script.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6e32a4f99202c212ffaa.html
